title: aphyllon corymbosum
intro: Aphyllon corymbosum, commonly known as Toothache Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat toothaches and other oral health issues due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Aphyllon corymbosum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial properties which can help to prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
